title: Rent certificates
description: Tenants ask in the LINE app for a visa, a bank or an employer; the receipts of the period are gathered for you.
noneWaitingBody: When a tenant asks for a certificate it appears here and you are notified.

actions.issueBody: The receipts of the period and any overdue amount go into a letter in your name, sent to the tenant in LINE.
actions.declineBody: The tenant sees this reason in LINE.
